BiblicalUsage: Mequts'ah is the corner, the angle where two sides of the tabernacle meet. Exodus 26:23 orders two boards for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides, and Exodus 36:28 says Bezalel made them just so.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the corners matter because God gave their measure too: nothing in His house was left to guesswork.
